title: Ozero Mail
description: Ozero Mail: a private mail app for all your accounts on Android and iOS. No AI, no subscription, nothing in between.
h1: One inbox. No AI. Nothing in between.
sub: A private mail app for all your accounts, on Android and iOS. This page is an inbox too: read it, then clear it.
tip: Swipe a letter left or press Done.
tipKey: Keys: E for Done, U to undo.
name: Khizri
s1: I tried every mail app. None fit.
s2: I don't read your mail. Neither does a robot.
s3: Six reasons you'll hit zero by lunch
s7: Why not Apple Mail, Spark or Gmail?
m1a: The private ones felt like settings panels. The friendly ones fed my mail to AI. So I'm building the one I want to use every day.
m1b: There's no corporation, team or investor behind it. When you buy Ozero Deep, the money goes to me.
shotLabel: The app's unified inbox: letters from four accounts, each with its own color stripe
wipText: All of this is being built right now. The app isn’t out yet, and details may change.
rc4: Ozero Deep, planned: your own rules, templates, send later, saved searches, settings sync
proNote: Ozero Deep is a plan for now, after the free app ships. Once it’s out, try any of it for 14 days, no card needed.
tipText: Free is enough? Great. If you still want to thank me, there’s a tip jar, and your name goes on the thank-you list.

privacy: No AI summaries, no AI replies. Not now, not in Ozero Deep.
Sorting happens on your phone, by rules you can read.
Your mail goes from your provider straight to your phone. My servers never see it.

features.p: Every account in one list, each with its own color.
Done archives a letter. Snooze brings it back later.
Every control within reach of your thumb.
Opens instantly, syncs quietly in the background.
Services and newsletters wait in their own tabs.
Built separately for Android and for iOS.

comparison.p: Good if all your devices are Apple. Ozero Mail works on Android too.
Built around their own service, with AI that reads your mail.
A great inbox, but with a subscription and built-in AI.
Private, but heavy on settings. Ozero Mail is made for one hand.

promises.p: Free stays free. Nothing moves behind a paywall.
Your password goes to your provider, never to me.
A public roadmap and a changelog for every update.
Every email gets a reply from me.

questions.a: No. I never get a copy. Instant alerts for Gmail and Outlook pass through a tiny relay that only hears “something new arrived”.
Yes: Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP mail, as many accounts as you like.

questions.q: What if you stop working on it?
questions.a: The app doesn’t need my servers to work with your mail, so it keeps working. Your mail stays with your provider, and Ozero Deep stays yours.
It’s Russian for “lake”, and it ends in “zero”. Calm water, empty inbox.
